findings.location: Main text, paragraph beginning “As we step back…”
findings.source_quote: “who will be the best option to lead the country after the upcoming election.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “after the upcoming election” as آنے والے انتخابات کے بعد, rather than انتخابات کے بعد, so the timing remains explicit.
findings.translation_quote: “آنے والے انتخابات کے بعد ملک کی قیادت کے لیے کون بہتر انتخاب ہوگا۔”

findings.suggested_fix: Translate this affirmation as “ہمیں امید ہے!” or “ہم امید رکھتے ہیں!”; avoid wording that means “we need hope.”

findings.source_quote: “This is according to His fact, not according to our feeling.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “His fact” as “اس کی حقیقت” (or an equivalent phrase meaning God’s fact/reality), not “the fact of this matter.”
findings.translation_quote: “یہ بات ہمارے احساس کے مطابق نہیں بلکہ اس کی حقیقت کے مطابق ہے۔”
